prompt: Classify the visible hand. Reply with exactly one label and no explanation: open_palm, fist, index_pinch, pinkie_pinch, unknown. open_palm: fingers extended, palm facing camera. fist: fingers curled closed. index_pinch: thumb touching index fingertip, other fingers extended. pinkie_pinch: thumb touching little fingertip, other fingers extended. unknown: no clear hand, relaxed hand, ambiguous posture, or cannot tell. Distinguish which finger touches the thumb; do not guess when unclear.
timing: Preprocessing + generation + decoding, CUDA synchronized; excludes video decode, model loading, and one warmup.
